purpose: Measure the interaction order of four gauge-invariant, lineage-certified rank-one residual-stream projectors on held-out graph-reachability prompts.
claim_boundary: This experiment can show whether coordinated activation-projector attenuation has stable non-additive effects on a frozen Qwen-0.8B task score. It does not authorize signed or disparate weight edits, establish a global rank-four fiber, demonstrate compactification, or provide evidence of recursive self-improvement.

intervention.object: centered rank-one orthogonal projector at the final prompt token
intervention.formula: h_prime = h - alpha * v * v^T * (h - mu)
intervention.gauge_invariance: The projector vv^T is invariant under v -> -v.
intervention.selected_arm: top rank-one between-class-scatter direction reconstructed from construction rows
intervention.matched_random_arm: seeded Haar direction orthogonalized against the selected direction at each site
intervention.cube: all 16 binary subsets of four site-local projectors

outcome.primary: teacher-forced mean log probability of the registered completion

analysis.interaction_basis: Boolean multilinear monomials over the four on/off interventions
analysis.primary_comparison: leave-one-subcondition-out prediction SSE for degree<=1 versus degree<=2
analysis.higher_order_report: per-prompt exact order-energy spectrum through degree 4

stop_rules.resource_cap_abort: report aborted and retain completed work units
stop_rules.liveness_failure: report instrument_not_live; do not interpret interaction order
